data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-time Dashboard with Live Metrics
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time with new data.
Includes line chart for LLM cost over time.
Includes bar chart for stage completion rates.
Includes area chart for success rate trends.

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js.
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts.
Success rates are shown using Chart.js visualizations.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics including TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance.
Radar chart shows adherence to SOLID principles.
Metrics are clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.

features.title: 8-Stage Pipeline Visualization
features.description: Visualize the 8-stage pipeline of Artemis using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 stages are represented in a clear chart.
Chart is interactive and easy to understand.
Pipeline stages are accurately depicted.

features.title: Results Section with Real Metrics
features.description: Present real metrics from recent runs in the results section.
acceptance_criteria: Results section includes actual data from recent runs.
Data is presented in a clear and concise manner.
Metrics are relevant and up-to-date.

features.title: HERO Section: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a HERO section introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: HERO section clearly explains what Artemis is.
Visuals are engaging and informative.
Section is prominently displayed at the start of the presentation.

features.title: Chart.js Animations and Interactive Elements
features.description: Enhance visualizations with animations and interactive elements using Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Charts include smooth animations.
Interactive elements respond to user input.
Enhancements improve user engagement.

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies.
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is included and functional.

features.title: Auto-advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality with navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design a professional presentation with a gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth.
Overall design is professional and cohesive.
